findings.chapter: Ch. 1 — It All Starts With the First Token (§1.1.2); recurrence in Ch. 7 §7.1.1 and §7.2.1
findings.evidence: "the low end of that range is the older/edge tier rather than a published figure for a current frontier model [HYPOTHESIS]" (PDF p. 27, book p. 3). Also Ch 7 §7.1.1 caveat box ending "...before that budget's arithmetic is reused for a different generation mechanism. [DERIVED]" and Ch 7 §7.2.1 ending "...so video keys and values cannot simply be retained as immutable prefix entries for every later step. [DERIVED]" (both PDF p. 154)
findings.issue: Bare Axis-2 evidence tags with no Axis-1 provenance partner. The Preface states: "A label pair always takes one item from each of the first two axes" and "Every load-bearing quantitative claim carries Axes 1 and 2 as an inline pair". The tagged [HYPOTHESIS] in Ch 1 and the boxed [DERIVED] caveats in Ch 7 carry only the epistemic tag, so the provenance axis is missing exactly where the book's discipline says it must be present.
findings.fix_instruction: Add provenance partners (e.g. [canonical scenario][HYPOTHESIS] for the context-window range claim; [canonical scenario][DERIVED] for the two Ch 7 caveat boxes), or add a stated exception for caveat-box tags in the Sources, Method, and Reproducibility chapter.
